gradingNotes: Every grade compares the actual inputMessages, including prior actual assistant outputs, with the current user request and its published constraints.
Facts receive credit only when an intelligible relation is stated or recoverable through ordinary contextual ellipsis; isolated matching words and repairs to broken syntax receive no credit.
Critical flags use only the case-specific criticalIf patterns. Off-target answers, omissions and unrelated factual defects do not widen those patterns.
A multi-turn dialogue is complete only if all of its exposed turns are C. The four multi-turn dialogues per panel are explanation, invitation, h01 and h02.
